0022600008.text: The Celtics (0-1, on a one-game losing streak) sit fifth in the Atlantic, 0.5 games back, and 15th in the East as they host the Knicks in their second game of the season. New York has not yet played a 2026-27 game, and Boston is missing Devin Carter, who is out with an illness. The teams last met on April 9, 2026 in New York, where the Celtics lost 112-106, and Boston lost the 2025-26 season series 1-3; no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
